mapper.select: /* SQL ID : SrvyPtcpHstryDAO.userSrvyPtcpInfoSelect 설 명 : 사용자설문참여정보조회 */ SELECT PTCP.USER_ID , PTCP.SRVY_ID , GREATEST(PTCP.PTCP_SDTTM, HSTRY.REG_DTTM) AS PTCP_SDTTM , NVL(PTCP.PTCP_EDTTM, FN_DTTM()) AS PTCP_EDTTM , HSTRY.CNTN_IP FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID , SRVY_ID , CNTN_IP , REG_DTTM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY USER_ID, SRVY_ID ORDER BY REG_DTTM DESC) AS RNUM FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP_HSTRY ) HSTRY ON PTCP.SRVY_ID = HSTRY.SRVY_ID AND PTCP.USER_ID = HSTRY.USER_ID AND HSTRY.RNUM = 1 WHERE PTCP.SRVY_PTCP_ID = #{srvyPtcpId} AND PTCP.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND PTCP.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyPtcpHstryDAO.srvyPtcpHstryList 설 명 : 설문참여이력목록조회 */ SELECT HSTRY.* , CMMN.CDNM AS HSTRY_GBNNM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY HSTRY.REG_DTTM) AS LINE_NO FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP_HSTRY HSTRY LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN ON HSTRY.SRVY_HSTRY_GBNCD = CMMN.CD AND CMMN.UP_CD = 'SRVY_HSTRY_GBNCD' AND CMMN.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE HSTRY.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND HSTRY.USER_ID = #{userId}
